condition_evidence.claim_is_atomic: a second worker's claim on a held job was refused, by a unique index rather than by a check with a race window in front of it
condition_evidence.cycle_completed: a worker cycle ran and its own invariants were clean
condition_evidence.expired_lease_reclaimed: a lease past its expiry was taken by another worker, so a worker that dies holding a claim does not block a job forever
condition_evidence.no_collector_invoked: zero, and no code path in this gate reaches one
condition_evidence.only_transient_retries: activation, terms and human-review refusals are not retried. Retrying them would burn the budget on jobs no worker can ever run.
condition_evidence.retries_are_bounded: a retry decision at the attempt budget returned should_retry false

note: built with no cycle supplied, so worker_runtime_ready is false here. That is the shape of the lane, not a health reading - the live reading comes from scripts/verify_nativeforge_source_worker_runtime.sh.
worker_ready_is_not_monitoring_live: worker_runtime_ready says a worker claims jobs and records outcomes. source_monitoring_live says something is polling a source. Nothing is: every job refuses, because none is approved.
